title: Binance Futures Will List USDⓈ-M & COIN-M Quarterly 1225 Delivery Contracts
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will list the following  USDⓈ-M and COIN-M Quarterly 1225 Delivery Contracts  a few hours after the USDⓈ-M and COIN-M Quarterly 0626 Delivery Contracts expire and settle at  2026-06-26 08:00 (UTC) .   USDⓈ-M BTC and ETH Quarterly 1225 Delivery Contracts USDⓈ-M Delivery Contracts BTCUSDT Quarterly 1225 ETHUSDT Quarterly 1225 Launch Time After 2026-06-26 08:00 (UTC) Underlying Asset BTC ETH Settlement Asset USDT USDT Tick Size 0.1 0.01 Max Leverage 50x Trading Hours 24/7 COIN-M BTC, ETH, BNB, XRP, and SOL Quarterly 1225 Delivery Contracts COIN-M Delivery Contracts BTCUSD CM Quarterly 1225 ETHUSD CM Quarterly 1225 BNBUSD CM Quarterly 1225 XRPUSD CM Quarterly 1225 SOLUSD CM Quarterly 1225 Launch Time After 2026-06-26 08:00 (UTC) Underlying Asset BTC ETH BNB XRP SOL Settlement Asset BTC ETH BNB XRP SOL Tick Size 0.1 0.01 0.01 0.0001 0.01 Max Leverage 50x 20x Trading Hours 24/7 Notes: Users are only allowed to close their positions or place Reduce Only orders, and are  not  allowed to open any new positions  ten minutes  prior to delivery. For further information, please refer to  Delivery and Settlement of Quarterly Futures .  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-06-18
